title: Porogaramu zo gutambutsa
intro: Huza porogaramu itambutsa nka BUTT ukoresheje amagenamiterere akurikira. Andika aderesi ya seriveri na porudi ku gikubo cya BUTT cya "Main", uhuze n'amagenamiterere y'imiterere ku gikubo cyayo cya "Stream".
regenerateSuccess: Ijambobanga ryongeye gukorwa. Vugurura BUTT mbere yo kongera guhuza.
confirmBody: Ijambobanga rihari rihita ritagira icyo rimaze. Porogaramu itambutsa yose ihujwe n'iryambere izacibwa.
